criteria.label: Overall quality
criteria.question: Which set of images looks better overall?
criteria.hint: Judge each set as a whole, taking all of its images together: detail, colour, and anything that looks wrong, blurry or broken.

criteria.label: Seamlessness
criteria.question: Which set blends together more seamlessly?
criteria.hint: Across the images in each set, look at where the parts meet. Are there visible joins, hard edges, or abrupt changes in texture where one region ends and the next begins?

criteria.label: Overall coherence
criteria.question: In which set do the images make more sense as single scenes?
criteria.hint: Ignore the joins themselves and the picture quality. Across each set, ask whether the parts of each image belong together: consistent lighting, scale and perspective, and a scene that holds together rather than unrelated things placed side by side.

criteria.label: Prompt alignment
criteria.question: Which set matches its descriptions better?
criteria.hint: Each numbered image has its own descriptions, the same for that number in both sets. Every description should be visible somewhere in its image.
